en.answer:
It can be activated.

en.question: In a situation where an opponent's monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck has changed control with the ①st effect of <<16880>>, if that monster is destroyed, can the『If a face-up "D/D/D" and/or "Dark Contract" card(s) you control, except "<<21769>>", is destroyed while this card is face-up in your Extra Deck, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card, then you can destroy 1 card on the field』monster effect of <<21769>> be activated?
en.title: If a monster that changed control with the effect of <<16880>> and is treated as a "D/D/D" monster is destroyed, can the ①st monster effect of <<21769>> be activated?

ja.answer:
発動できます。
（フィールドに存在する時のカード名を参照するためです。）

以下のカードの効果を発動するための条件についても、フィールドに存在するときのカード名を参照します。
